crossRefs.note: I am poured out like water. All my bones are out of joint. My heart is like wax. It is melted within me.
My soul is weary with sorrow: strengthen me according to your word.
Even he who is valiant, whose heart is as the heart of a lion, will utterly melt; for all Israel knows that your father…
Therefore all hands will be feeble, and everyone’s heart will melt.
She is empty, void, and waste. The heart melts, the knees knock together, their bodies and faces have grown pale.

translations.web: They mount up to the sky; they go down again to the depths. Their soul melts away because of trouble.
translations.bsb: They mounted up to the heavens, then sunk to the depths; their courage melted in their anguish.
translations.kjv: They mount up to the heaven, they go down again to the depths: their soul is melted because of trouble.
translations.asv: They mount up to the heavens, they go down again to the depths: Their soul melteth away because of trouble.
